_what: What the computer's programs write to their log and what they hold back (computer/log-policy.mjs, used by computer/mac-tools.mjs for every line it and the program host log). `events` names, per event (the `event` of a line, or the first key of one), how it is logged: one of `modes`. `default_mode` applies to an event not listed, and the first such event is reported once by name so adding its row is reviewable. A mode row says whether the line is dropped (`drop`) or compared with an earlier line of the same event (`compare`: `last` writes only when the line differs from the last written, `seen` writes only the first). `ignore_when_comparing` are keys that change on every line (a retry wait) and so never make a line different. `redact` replaces, at the point of writing, the value of any key whose name matches `key_patterns`, and any text matching `text_patterns` (a signed token, a bearer header), by `replacement`. `most_remembered_events` bounds what is kept.
